title: Planning a Trip
subtitle: Booking flights and a hotel — for English learners

sentences.en: I've been thinking we should finally take that trip to the coast next month.
sentences.target: I've been thinking we should finally take that trip to the coast next month.

sentences.en: I'd love that. How many days were you thinking — a long weekend or a full week?
sentences.target: I'd love that. How many days were you thinking — a long weekend or a full week?

sentences.en: Five days would be perfect. We can fly out on a Wednesday and come back Sunday.
sentences.target: Five days would be perfect. We can fly out on a Wednesday and come back Sunday.

sentences.en: I just checked and round-trip flights are around three hundred dollars per person.
sentences.target: I just checked and round-trip flights are around three hundred dollars per person.

sentences.en: That's reasonable. Should we book directly with the airline or through a travel site?
sentences.target: That's reasonable. Should we book directly with the airline or through a travel site?

sentences.en: Booking directly is usually better in case there are any cancellations or changes.
sentences.target: Booking directly is usually better in case there are any cancellations or changes.

sentences.en: What about the hotel? Do you want something downtown or closer to the beach?
sentences.target: What about the hotel? Do you want something downtown or closer to the beach?

sentences.en: Let's stay near the beach. Even if it costs a little more, the view is worth it.
sentences.target: Let's stay near the beach. Even if it costs a little more, the view is worth it.

sentences.en: I found a small hotel with free breakfast and good reviews — about a hundred a night.
sentences.target: I found a small hotel with free breakfast and good reviews — about a hundred a night.

sentences.en: Perfect. Let's book everything tonight before the prices go up.
sentences.target: Let's book everything tonight before the prices go up.

sentences.en: I can't wait. We really need a break from work.
sentences.target: I can't wait. We really need a break from work.
